work.composition: diving plane upper, weeping figure lower
work.description: Layered digital collage featuring a rendered Stuka dive-bomber descending over partial cyan text, above a pale grid field populated with concentric target circles and a cubist-style reclining figure; two compact discs appear at left edge and lower center, with a horizontal orange-red gradient band bisecting the lower third.
work.title: Stuka, Watch Out
